name: Siege: Dark Reign Prelude and Essential Tie-Ins
description: Norman Osborn's rise and fall, from a Dark Reign prelude beginning in 2008 to the 2010 Siege of Asgard. Follow Dark Avengers, New Avengers, Mighty Avengers, Avengers: The Initiative and Thunderbolts, with the complete four-issue Siege event and selected crossover chapters. The prelude includes the Deadpool/Thunderbolts crossover and Utopia; the event finishes with New Avengers Finale.
sourceOrigin: Project-curated selection from Comic Book Herald's Dark Reign and Siege guides
